title: Count lines, words, and characters in a file
summary: Use the `wc` command without flags to count lines, words, and characters (bytes) in a file all at once.

steps.explain: Run the `wc` command followed by the path to your file. By default, it counts lines, words, and bytes.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: The path to the file you want to analyze.

steps.expect: The terminal will output three numbers: lines, words, and bytes, followed by the filename.
